notes: Harbor Point runs the same vendor product as Pine Ridge Federal Credit Union, two minor versions ahead (10.1.3 vs 9.2.14).

Almost every difference between the two needs no override at all. The navigation link resolves through {{vocab.member}}; the unlabelled search box resolves by the caption printed beside it, whatever that caption says; and the results row is matched by member number even though this build inserts a Segment column ahead of Name — which is exactly what breaks a column-index locator.
One genuine structural difference remains, and it is what this overlay exists for: this build ships with the deposit-account balances collapsed behind an explicit Display control.

Recorded degradation to watch: the base capability's idPattern hints (ctl\d+_Main_*) do not match this build's generated ids (ctl00_cphMain_*), so steps here resolve at 67-86 rather than 100. The capability works; the console reports that it is working less well here. That is the drift signal, visible before an incident rather than after one.

stepPatches.reason: Meridian 10.1 collapses the balances grid behind a Display control. Marked optional so this same overlay keeps working if the institution later changes that default.

step.intent: Reveal the deposit-account balances, which this institution's build hides by default

target.note: identified by name, resolved through this institution's vocabulary
